text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 126 tablets of sucralfate 1 g (16.6 days at 7.6 tablets per day) and Corvale General holds 193 tablets (18.9 days at 10.2 tablets per day). Both sites have less than three weeks of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show sucralfate is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21, and the earlier shortage first posted on 2023-01-04 has been resolved.

Our position: Current inventory is insufficient to sustain operations without replenishment. No active FDA shortage exists, so standard procurement channels are available.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase order with Allergan, Inc. (supplied from ABBVIE plant); requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. If Allergan cannot fulfill, buyer places order with Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC (New York plant last inspected NAI 2023-06-07); requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. If needed, buyer places order with Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. (TEVA plant); requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer evaluates AvKARE and Chartwell RX, LLC as backup sources; requires Pharmacy Director approval before ordering.
5. Buyer reports confirmed receipt dates and updated days-of-supply to P&T Committee at next meeting; requires P&T Committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or therapeutic substitution at this time.
